text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 18, 2024) for 310 The Kingsway.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 18, 2024) for 310 The Kingsway, Folder Number 24 199670 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Amended the By-law Section of Item 1 on the Property Standards Order (September 18, 2024) for 310 The Kingsway, Folder Number 24 199670 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(g)[1][b] OR 19.D.(3)(g)[2]. 3. Amended the order issue date on the Property Standards Order (September 18, 2024) for 310 The Kingsway, Folder Number 24 199670 PRS 00 IV to August 19, 2024.
